digest.component_or_area: fsck command suite and git utility store layer
propositions: Three filesystem primitives (_resolve_tracker_git_dir, _ticket_dirs, _dir_is_archived) are defined in fsck_repair.py but conceptually belong in the store layer and are imported by seven production modules, creating an inverted dependency where command-layer and store-layer code depends on a repair-specific module.
The three primitives must be moved from src/rebar/_commands/fsck_repair.py to src/rebar/_store/gitutil.py to eliminate the inverted dependency and improve code organization.

Backward-compatibility re-exports must be maintained in both fsck.py and fsck_repair.py as module-level bindings to preserve existing test patches and attribute access patterns without requiring test file modifications.
The move must preserve gitutil as a stdlib-only leaf with no module-level rebar imports, keeping _dir_is_archived's reducer dependency function-local as it was in fsck_repair.
